rationale: The plan selects limma-voom with a fixed-effects ~condition design and eBayes, which is exactly the method of choice for an unpaired 60 vs 60 single-batch cohort, and adds a Wilcoxon cross-check that is sensible at this n (the cited claim about NB false positives is overstated for n=60, but the chosen method is right regardless). Filtering (filterByExpr, min.count=10, grouped), TMM inside voom, an explicit control reference level and a named case-vs-control contrast, BH at 0.05, an in-model TREAT threshold rather than a post-hoc fold-change filter, and a p-value histogram diagnostic are all stated correctly; the apeglm shrinkage borrowed from a parallel DESeq2 fit is a slightly awkward cross-framework graft but is transparently scoped to effect-size reporting only. Enrichment is exemplary: camera with inter-gene correlation plus fgsea preranked on the moderated t, named collections with versions, tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window, leading edges, and an explicit refusal to run ORA on a short list. QC covers PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes with condition coloring and a flag-not-drop policy, but omits the sex check against XIST/Y-linked genes and any search for hidden structure with candidate factors, which is the main gap relative to the reference. Reporting is thorough, with versions, thresholds, gene counts, diagnostics, and a reproducibility record.
